title: Union Project Ceramics Studio Membership
source_quote: Participation in shared firings in the electric, soda, raku, and gas kilns.
evidence_sentence: The membership page states members can participate in shared firings in raku, soda, and gas kilns.
evidence_quote: Participation in shared firings in the electric, soda, raku, and gas kilns.
summary: Union Project's ceramics studio membership includes access to raku, soda, and gas kilns for shared firings. Members work in a shared studio with equipment access and can rent space in kilns for larger pieces.
how_to_join: Apply online at the membership application page
